videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript in Korean, limited to approximately 500 characters, and I must respond ONLY in Korean without using English at all.
Key points from the transcript:
1. Police conducted raid/seizure (압수수색) on Central and Regional Election Commissions regarding ballot paper shortage during local elections
2. Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency's Violent Crime Investigation Unit conducted raids at 7 locations including Gwacheon Central Election Commission starting 9 AM
3. Allegations: violation of Public Official Election Act, dereliction of duty
4. Focus: securing evidence to determine cause of infringement on voting rights
5. Court went to seize ballot boxes with quantities written on them but failed - Election Commission had already collected and sent to disposal company
6. Court requested factual inquiry and took additional measures
7. At Jamsil polling station, ballot box with "1900 copies" printed was found, but eligible voters were 3,800 (more than double)
8. Suspicion that Election Commission printed less than 50% of voters contrary to guidelines
9. Court accepted evidence preservation request for boxes and CCTV
10. Election Commission claimed boxes aren't legally required to be preserved, so they collected and transferred to disposal company
11. Election Commission claimed they printed according to internal guidelines
12. Court requested factual inquiry to locate the boxes
13. Election Commission's fact-finding committee (external members) confirmed no manual for ballot shortage response
14. Distribution failure was also a big problem
15. April document from Songpa-gu Election Commission: ordered 50% of eligible voters for most, but 60% for Jamsil 3-dong and 4-dong (low early voting rate)
16. At Jamsil 4-dong 567 polling station: shortage caused lines; at station 7: voting stopped 3 times for over an hour
17. Should have received 1,921 sheets (60% of eligible voters) but only got 1,400 (over 500 short - biggest shortage nationwide)
18. Meanwhile, Songpa-gu overall had over 42,000 unused ballots remaining
Summary structure (3-5 sentences, ~500 characters):
Police raid on Election Commission regarding ballot shortage
Failed to secure evidence (boxes already disposed)
Specific case: Jamsil polling station printed 50% or less instead of required amount, causing shortages
Distribution failure: Some stations lacked 500+ ballots while district had 42,000 surplus
Draft:
경찰이 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 중앙·지역선관위를 압수수색했습니다. 법원이 확보하려 한 투표지 상자 등 증거물은 선관위가 이미 폐기 업체로 넘겨 확보에 실패했습니다. 서울 잠실 일부 투표소는 유권자의 50%에도 미치지 않는 용지를 배부해 투표가 중단되는 등 참정권 침해가 발생했으나, 해당 구에는 사용하지 않은 투표지가 4만여 장 남아 있어 배분 실패 문제도 드러났습니다. 선관위는 보관 의무가 없다고 해명했으나 법원은 사실 조회를 신청하는 등 추가 조치에 나섰습니다.
